places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Augustus tips the boys ten dollars each; Lippy gets them drunk behind the livery, and they visit two whores upstairs over a saloon.

places.name: Hat Creek herd camp near Ogallala
places.note: After a spooked horse throws him, Newt walks the last two miles back and falls asleep holding cold beef.
places.location_hint: a few miles out of Ogallala, north of the Platte, Nebraska

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Lippy hopes the boys get drunk enough to forget Ogallala, even Nebraska.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Newt tells the whore Buf he has come up from Texas.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Lippy vows to master his new accordion before reaching it; Augustus calls it the far north.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Lippy still wears his shabby bowler from there; Newt recalls Lorena working at the Dry Bean.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.at: Hat Creek herd camp near Ogallala
groups.hint: north of the Platte a few miles from town; Pete Spettle's whereabouts unknown after his horse bolted

groups.label: Lippy and the Irishman
groups.hint: last seen on the saloon steps in town at night
